plan.purpose: Supplemental read-only MCP benchmark for five nontrivial native procedures per representative Zed, OpenUnity, and Figma Electron Framework binaries.
plan.target_policy: Read target files and REA-owned cache only. Do not launch, attach to, mutate, sign, save, or close a target application.

measurement_contract.order: Sequential workflows; reverse workflow order in even rounds.

qualification.candidate_rule: After the current official run, perform a read-only preflight for each exact candidate using procedure_assembly, read_function_instructions, and procedure_pseudo_code. Retain exactly five per target only when instruction decoding yields at least 8 instructions and at least 32 bytes of independently established extent, assembly is nonempty, and pseudocode is useful and does not report a bad-instruction halt. No unsupported procedure_info or address_to_file_offset call is required.
qualification.independent_extent_oracle: llvm-objdump arm64 disassembly plus Mach-O __unwind_info metadata or adjacent retained inventory starts are planning evidence only; the preflight result controls qualification.
qualification.selection_bias: The candidate set is address/name based and is not a random sample of the complete inventory.
qualification.no_correctness_claim: Nonempty assembly or pseudocode does not establish semantic correctness; compare repeated hashes and retain provider errors.

workflows.name: zed-native-functions-supplement
workflows.candidate_notes: Candidates are provisional until post-run preflight confirms exact address resolution, at least 8 decoded instructions, at least 32 bytes of independent extent, and useful nonempty pseudocode without a bad-instruction halt. Retain only qualified candidates for benchmark comparison.

workflows.name: openunity-native-functions-supplement
workflows.candidate_notes: Candidates are provisional until post-run preflight confirms exact address resolution, at least 8 decoded instructions, at least 32 bytes of independent extent, and useful nonempty pseudocode without a bad-instruction halt. Retain only qualified candidates for benchmark comparison.

workflows.name: figma-framework-native-functions-supplement
workflows.candidate_notes: Candidates are provisional until post-run preflight confirms exact address resolution, at least 8 decoded instructions, at least 32 bytes of independent extent, and useful nonempty pseudocode without a bad-instruction halt. Retain only qualified candidates for benchmark comparison.

limitations: Qualification verifies provider output shape, coverage, repeat stability, and independent extent evidence; it does not establish semantic correctness.
The two degraded Zed candidates have nonempty output and decoded instructions but no independently established extent of at least 32 bytes in this plan.
The preflight did not test fresh-process import reconstruction.
Candidate selection is address/name based and is not a random sample of each binary.

workflow.name: zed-native-functions-supplement
workflow.candidate_notes: Candidates are provisional until post-run preflight confirms exact address resolution, at least 8 decoded instructions, at least 32 bytes of independent extent, and useful nonempty pseudocode without a bad-instruction halt.
